case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 4070-4075 OF 2012, CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 4076-4082 OF 2012, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4086 OF 2012, CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 4083-4084 OF 2012
summary: The appeals challenged the confirmation of Rs.4 lakhs per acre as compensation for land acquired under notification dated 26.10.1990 in Villages Sohana and Lakhnaur. The High Court upheld the Reference Court's award, which relied on a prior award in respect of Village Lakhnaur under the same notification. Appellants argued for higher compensation based on awards in adjacent villages (Kambali) and later notifications, but the Court found Kambali not in close proximity and rejected use of subsequent awards affected by intervening development. Absence of sale instances led the Court to rely on prior awards. Applying 10% annual appreciation from 1981 base value also did not exceed Rs.4 lakhs by 1990. No error found in upheld award.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894
State of Punjab v. Mohinder Singh & Ors.
Harbachan Kaur & Ors. v. State of Punjab
